description.narrative: The main objective of UNICEF project is to ensure access to basic health services and multi-sectoral needs of displaced children and their families living in areas controlled or under the influence of armed groups. The project provides hygiene and sanitation products and services, emergency nutritional intervention package and life-saving primary health care. The intervention provides humanitarian assistance to 121,000 people, of which 13,000 men, 22,000 women and 86,000 children, including 11,100 people with disabilities.
